verdict.rationale: Formant clearly supports on-robot data capture via its Agent SDK/Docker install and cloud sync/query via the Cloud SDK and Analytics, evidencing the core telemetry pipeline (formant-docs-1, formant-docs-2, formant-docs-3, formant-docs-20). However, no evidence describes bandwidth-aware sync policies, adaptive upload throttling, or offline buffering strategies explicitly. Missing for 10: documented bandwidth-aware/adaptive sync configuration, offline queuing/backpressure controls, independent confirmation of these policies in practice.
